summary: Solve a fresh five-letter puzzle each day.
page_description: A daily five-letter word puzzle you can play anywhere, with or without Wi-Fi.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody who wants one small word puzzle a day.
job: Solve today's five-letter word and keep the streak going.
offline: The puzzle and your guesses live on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.kind: today's puzzle in progress and your streak
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it exists so a half-guessed word continues

non_goals: It does not download new words.
It does not post your score anywhere.
